_about: Jane-Sixty calibration v0. Every entry is {value, source}. Source tags: service-notes (Juno-60 Service Notes, April 1983, page), owners-manual, schematic (read from the Service Notes drawings), published-measurement (named), simulation (to come), plugin-derived (sanity check only), assumed. See docs/research/05-manual-verified-facts.md.

qCompensation.source: plugin-derived; confirmed to about 2 dB by the loudness balance of resonant vs non-resonant patches in the factory demo recording (docs/calibration-report.md). The p.9 network with an ideal BA662 predicts the opposite sign; the chip's input weighting is the open item

anchorSliderPos.source: service-notes p.22 Table 6 patch 84, p.24 adj.8-2

trimOffsetOct.source: assumed: unit trim. The factory demo recording sits about 1.2 octaves above the Service Notes trim at every FREQ setting (tools/listen, docs/research/10); 0 restores the manual's calibration

keyFollowPivotNote.source: service-notes p.24 adj.8-3 (C4 = 248 Hz with KYBD 10)

lfoFullDepthOct.source: service-notes p.24 adj.8-7 (40..50 Hz to 4..5 kHz)

passbandLossAtMaxResDb.source: plugin-derived (PicoFaceJ6 vs Roland plugin); replace by simulation

cornerHz.source: schematic p.11 caps 0.022/0.01/0.0047 uF with 47 k (R derived); position 0 flat per owners-manual p.14

sumGainPerVoice.source: schematic p.9: each voice through R50 27 k into the IC23 (TA75558) summer with R369 3.3 k feedback

sumToChorusInput.source: schematic p.9: R370 3.3 k series, R371 10 k to ground, to TP8 / SIG OUT (the chorus board input)

attackSeconds.source: endpoints service-notes p.25 adj.10 (3 s) and spec (1 ms); 2.5/5/7.5 points published-measurement pendragon-andyh scaled 3.25 to 3.0; odd points interpolated (assumed)

decaySeconds.source: endpoints owners-manual p.32 spec (2 ms, 12 s); 2.5/5/7.5 points published-measurement pendragon-andyh scaled 19.8 to 12; odd points interpolated (assumed)

releaseSeconds.source: as decaySeconds (release table measured identical to decay)

timingCapNf.source: assumed: AMSynths IR3R01 note for Juno-6/60, confirm on schematic p.9

rateHz.source: endpoints owners-manual spec 0.3 Hz and service-notes p.23 adj.7-1 (22 Hz); 2.5/5/7.5 published-measurement pendragon-andyh; odd points interpolated (assumed)

delayHoldSeconds.source: service-notes p.24 adj.7-4 (2 s at 10); 2.5/5/7.5 published-measurement pendragon-andyh (2.69 at 10 on that unit, scaled); odd points interpolated (assumed)

dryGain.source: schematic p.11: IC8 summers, dry through R89 / R88 39 k into 100 k feedback (R95 / R91), normalised to 1

wetGain.source: schematic p.11: wet through R86 / R87 47 k into the same 100 k feedback: 39 / 47 relative to dry

bbdClipVpp.source: service-notes p.25 chorus bias-adjustment test signal: 6 Vp-p 1 kHz sine at TP8 (CPU board, the chorus input) with VCA LEVEL approx. 0 and CHORUS I; bias set so TP1 is not clipped. A test condition, not a measured clipping onset

bbdClipRoomV.source: assumed: MN3009 soft overload width above the knee; replace by measurement

preRealHz.source: schematic-derived pole set (jpcima, Juno-6 clone netlist): 10 k + 2.2 nF at the BBD input

preAHz.source: schematic-derived (jpcima): 22 k x2, 820 pF / 680 pF Sallen-Key

preBHz.source: schematic-derived (jpcima): 22 k x2, 1.8 nF / 270 pF Sallen-Key

postRealHz.source: schematic-derived (jpcima): 3.3 k x2 sum into 47 k / 2.2 nF

voicing._about: Provisional output voicing with no circuit source. Zero lowShelfDb to hear the bare model.

lowShelfDb.source: assumed: listening fit against the factory demo recordings (the originals sit about 10 to 15 % heavier below 150 Hz); replace by measurement
